column1: # Characters where pypinyin's usual reading is NOT the one that goes with the meaning taught on this site.
# The pinyin check normally compares the shown pinyin with pypinyin. For these characters it also accepts the reading below.

column3: reason
long (cháng); pypinyin's default zhǎng means "to grow, chief"
the verb "to teach" (jiāo); pypinyin's default jiào is for 教室, 教育
the particle after an adverb (高兴地说); dì is only inside words like 地铁
the particle after a verb (说得好); dé is only inside words like 获得
the experience particle (去过); guò is the verb and is inside 过来, 过去, 过年
dirty (zāng); pypinyin default zàng is for organs (内脏, 心脏)
kind, type (zhǒng) in 这种, 各种, 一种; pypinyin guesses zhòng (to plant) before a noun like 花
must (děi) before a verb: 我得走了; pypinyin guesses de or dé
to get (dé) in 得了 + a number: 他考试得了一百分
photo (zhàopiàn) in 照片; pypinyin reads it piān, which is only the spoken form with 儿 (照片儿)
to drop, to lower (jiàng, as in 降低 and 降价); pypinyin gives xiáng ("to surrender") in 降低
量 as a verb (to measure: 量体重, 量了量) is liáng; pypinyin reads liàng in these phrases
弹 = to play an instrument (tán); pypinyin reads dàn after 他 and in the bare word
适应 and 答应: yìng; pypinyin reads yīng (the reading of 应该)
血 in speech is xiě (the reading of the official list); pypinyin gives xuè
一只 / 两只 (measure word for animals and one of a pair) is zhī; pypinyin gives zhǐ in 两只袜子
好 after a verb or doubled (教好, 好好学习) is hǎo; pypinyin reads hào in some of these
背 = to carry on the back (bēi: 背着, 背包); pypinyin reads bèi
待 = to stay (dāi: 待在家里, 待一会儿); pypinyin reads dài
肚子 (belly) is dùzi; pypinyin reads dǔ (that is 羊肚, tripe)
大夫 (doctor) is dàifu; pypinyin reads dàfū
相 is xiāng in 相同, 相比 and 互相 (each other, mutual); pypinyin guesses xiàng for 相同
